notes.title: Beyond Patch Notes - v1.1.3 - Save The Plants!
notes.content:
--- Fixed a bug that prevented Solanum Seed Ejector from property ejecting new ships when building. 
--- Reduced Solanum Enrich cost to 100%, from 125%.

notes.title: Beyond Patch Notes - v1.1.2 - Bug Fixification
notes.content: --- Fixed a bug that could prevent the Intel and Tech menus from opening when on a 1 human player custom game.

notes.title: Beyond Patch Notes - v1.1.1 - Changing The Oil For Improved PewPewPew!
notes.content:
Under The Hood 🏎️🚨😱
--- Enemy AI optimizations to speed things up when there are a lot of baddies. 😡😡😡
--- Game Engine Upgrade: This should have no effect on anything... 🤞🤞🤞☠️☠️☠️
--- Google Play Services Upgrade: This should also have no effect on anything... 😨😨😨💀💀💀
--- Apple App Store Backend Upgrade: How ever do I pray to all of the programming gods that this one has no effect on anything either... 😖😞😦😧😨🤢🤮
--- Quite a few code optimization adjustments to go along with these updates, so we'll see if any typos snuck in. 🙈

💩 Code BLARG!
--- Custom Game Menu bug fixes to show the proper number of enemies after reducing to one planet. On mobile, when changing from enemy to human, prevents selection of an unavailable species.
--- Fixed a bug that could cause a game to end prematurely if no ships were present at the end of a turn.
--- Yet more black hole edge case bug fixes... These stellar pieces of junk. 😖

Mostly Meaningless 🙈
--- Updated Game IDs for Custom Games.
--- Adjusted Probes on Mobile Nano Extractor graphic to not block HP and AP display.
